SELECT
    c.Occupation AS customer_segment,
    sum(f.SalesAmount) - sum(f.TotalCost) AS gross_margin,
    (sum(f.SalesAmount) - sum(f.TotalCost)) / nullif(sum(f.SalesAmount), 0) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
INNER JOIN retail.DimCustomer AS c
    ON f.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
WHERE c.Occupation IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.Occupation
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 1
